notes: If something you ask for needs Crisp Pro, such as Max quality or a second job while one is running, Crisp now opens the window with the Buy button. Before, it could show a message you couldn’t click. Photos are now sized from their own size. “Make it 4K” on a 1080p photo makes it 4K, not 8K. “Make it 1080p” on a small photo now reaches 1080p. If a photo is already the size you ask for, Crisp says so instead of upscaling it again.
